title: Restore power settings to defaults
summary: Reset all power management settings to their system defaults if you have changed them and want to start over.

steps.explain: Use sudo pmset -a to set all power management settings (display sleep, disk sleep, system sleep, wake on modem port) to their default values.
steps.cmd: sudo pmset -a displaysleep 10 disksleep 10 sleep 30 womp 1

rollback.explain: There is no single command to undo this reset. You must manually re-apply any custom settings you had before.

warnings: This command overwrites all current custom power settings with defaults. Make sure you know your previous settings if you want to restore them later.
